why: Decision 118: the player ships its engine rather than downloading it on first
use. The upstream project keeps thirty days of builds, so a pinned URL is a
time bomb - the first installation attempted a month later would 404, and a
checksum that cannot be fetched cannot be verified.
Only windows/amd64 is pinned, because Windows is the only platform V3.3 can be
verified on. A macOS or Linux build needs its own pin, its own digest and its
own run on real hardware before it appears here: an entry nobody has executed
would be a claim, not a pin.
